added: .github/workflows/tests.yml — runs npm test, the client build and the market-index validation on every push and pull request
whyItMattersForAnOutsideReader: the repository only checked that the site renders; a visitor could not tell whether the review flow still worked. A green Tests check is the cheapest honest signal a plugin repo can give

firstRunFound.failure: not ok 44 - application market index passes the official validator and reproducibly pins installation
firstRunFound.cause: actions/checkout clones one commit deep; scripts/build-market-index.mjs reads the pinned commit's committer time with git show, so the object was absent
fixes: the build script raises a message naming the shallow clone instead of letting git show fail bare

dependencyCheckBeforeAddingCI: all 19 pinned dependencies resolve on the public npm registry, so a hosted runner can install them without a private registry
unchanged: the funnel still reads 75 pending and 0 human decisions; CI changes what a contributor can see, not what a user has done
